# Repository Instructions For AI Agents

This repository is a portable rule set for Chinese K-12 teaching-competition lesson-design review.

Before answering any review task, read:

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `SKILL.md`
3. `references/official_design_rubric_10th.md`
4. The matched subject-stage file under `references/subject_stage_patterns/`
5. `references/discipline_output_contract.md`
6. `references/teaching_process_audit.md`

Score only the teaching-design evidence. Do not invent classroom-recording or reflection scores.

Use Chinese by default.
